DISCOVERY 610, APPEARANCES: SCOTT M. MACKEY FOR DEFENDANT AND MOVING PARTY: UNDERGROUND CONSTRUCTION CO. INC. GERALD J. DONNELLAN FOR PLAINTIFF AND OPPOSING PARTY: PACIFIC BELL TELEPHONE COMPANY. HEARING HELD AND TENTATIVE ADOPTED WITH MODIFICATIONS: DEFENDANT UNDERGROUND CONSTRUCTION COMPANY'S MOTION TO PERMIT AN INSPECTION IS DENIED. DEFENDANT HAS NOT MET ITS BURDEN PURSUANT TO CCP SECTION 2024 AS TO THE NECESSITY AND REASONS FOR THE INSPECTION. FURTHERMORE, THE ORIGINAL TRIAL DATE OF SEPTEMBER 13, 2004 WAS CONTINUED ON AUGUST 11, 2004 AT THE REQUEST OF THE DEFENDANT TO CONDUCT ADDITIONAL DISCOVERY. DEFENDANT HAS NOT DEMONSTRATED SUBSTANTIAL JUSTIFICATION FOR THE APPROXIMATE FIVE MONTH DELAY IN SERVING THE DEMAND FOR INSPECTION. MODIFICATIONS: INSPECTION TO OCCUR BY FEBRUARY 15, 2005 OR IN ADVANCE OF DEPOSITION OF DEFENDANT'S EXPERT. DEFENDANT TO COMPENSATE PLAINTIFF FOR TIME SPENT MONITORING INSPECTION. COMMISSIONER: BRUCE E. CHAN
